prompt: Gold sells hot soup on a cold day
title: Hot Soup Day
irony: Gold guards every drop to sell more soup, but the pot only empties into paying bowls after he starts giving small cups away.

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Frost feathers the diner windows as Gold's big pot steams and kids press red noses to the glass.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Green counts cold coins for soup, Navy echoes him, and Gold polishes spoons while warning extras cost extra.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: Purple bangs his truck drum across the road, shouting hot soup with dancing crackers, and the line drifts away.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: The whole diner chants for hot soup as steam curls up and cold hands wrap round warm bowls.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: Green recites steaming soup facts but fears a sip, Gold charges for warm bowls, and the soup cools untouched.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: Silver shivers in with chattering teeth, slips on the mat, and soup splashes Purple's tall hat to giggles.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: The diner chants for hot soup again as the pot steams low and the line stays thin outside.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: Gold watches Navy split his small bowl with cold hands around him and feels his tight chest loosen.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: Gold lifts the ladle high and pours small free cups for cold hands while Navy cheers.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: The crowd streams back for hot soup as free cups turn into full bowls and the till sings.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: The diner glows warm as everyone sips together and Gold pins a free-cup note to the pot.
